The [CDF](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-cdf) $F$
and the [quantile function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-quantile-function) $Q$
describe a probability distribution,
while $\hat F$ and $\hat Q$ describe a sample,
and serve as estimates of $F$ and $Q$.
